common.errorWithId: An error occurred (ID: {id}). Please contact your administrator

auth.loginTitle: Sign in with the account issued by your administrator.
auth.lockedMinutes: Account locked. Please try again in about {minutes} minutes

changePwd.title: Change Password
changePwd.policyHint: New password must be at least 10 characters

home.preparing: This area will be implemented in upcoming milestones

setup.title: Initial setup
setup.note: Complete these steps in order before going live. This guide hides itself once everything is done.

entry.title: Item Entry
entry.warehouseInDateHint: Optional. If filled in, it will not be overwritten by the warehouse-in scan
entry.nextCodeNote: The final code is issued when you save
entry.noBand: No price band matches this price
entry.penGuide: Write the item code on the tag or storage bag with an oil-based pen. Replace it with a printed label back at the office
entry.dictLoadFailed: Failed to load venues and price bands. Please reload
entry.photoReadFailed: Could not read the photo. Please try again
entry.photosHint: Photos upload automatically after saving (kept offline, sent when reconnected)

validation.priceMin: Purchase price must be at least 1 JPY
validation.feeMax: Fee must be at most 99,999,999 JPY

entry.reEntryNote: Correct the voided item and save. A new item code will be issued and photos carry over automatically.
entry.inheritedImagesNote: Photos from the voided item carry over on save (no need to retake).
entry.voidNote: Void this item and re-enter it under a new item code. The voided item will appear as voided in search and scans.
entry.voidLabelWarn: * Remove the old label of the voided item, or cross it out with a permanent marker.

print.title: Label Printing
print.empty: No items match. Adjust the date range.
print.guide: When printing, set scale to 100%, margins to none, and uncheck headers and footers.
print.reprintNotFound: No printable item found for this item code (voided and deleted items are excluded)

arrival.title: Arrival Check
arrival.loadFailed: Failed to load. Tap to retry
arrival.warehouseInDateHint: Leave blank to record as today
arrival.viewerNote: Confirming stock-in requires editor or admin role

scan.title: Scan
scan.cameraGuide: Hold the item's QR code up to the camera
scan.cameraDenied: Camera unavailable. Search by typing the code, or allow camera access in browser settings
scan.cameraInsecure: Camera requires an HTTPS connection. Please use manual entry
scan.cameraFailed: Could not start the camera. Please search by typing the code
scan.notFound: No item found for this code
scan.voidedWithReEntry: This item was voided. Its new code after re-entry is {code}
scan.voidedNoReEntry: This item was voided (not re-entered yet). Remove the old label or cross it out with an oil-based pen
scan.deletedNote: This item is deleted and cannot be operated on here
scan.viewerNote: Inventory operations require editor permission or higher
scan.noActions: No actions available in the current state

sell.title: Sell
sell.priceHint: If left blank, the price will be filled in later from the Yahoo Auction result
sell.priceInvalid: Enter a sale price between 1 and 99,999,999 yen

return.title: Return
return.customerHint: Accept a customer return and put the item back into stock
return.venueHint: Record a return to the auction venue (shipped out)

listed.title: Mark as listed
listed.note: Press this after listing the item on Yahoo Auction (including relisting after an unsold close). It is recorded as listed without waiting for the order import.

canceled.title: Mark listing canceled
canceled.note: Record an unsold close or a listing cancellation. Order files contain no cancel information, so this manual record is the only source.

stocktake.title: Stocktake
stocktake.activeExists: An active stocktake already exists for this warehouse
stocktake.viewerNote: Starting a stocktake requires editor permission or above

scan.title: Stocktake Scan
scan.guide: Scan each item's QR code in order
scan.warnFrozen: This item is voided or deleted. It was recorded, but cannot be adjusted in the review
scan.warnOtherWarehouse: This item belongs to another warehouse. Recorded (review it in the differences)
scan.warnNotInStock: This item is not in stock in the system. Recorded (review it in the differences)
scan.closeNote: Closing creates the difference list. No further scans are possible.
scan.cancelNote: This stocktake will be cancelled and its scans discarded.
scan.closedNote: This stocktake is closed. Continue to the difference review
scan.offlineCard: Recorded offline. It will be sent automatically once the connection recovers
scan.queuedNote: {n} scan(s) are not sent yet. They are sent automatically once the connection recovers; closing becomes available when all are delivered
scan.flushFailed: Scans that could not be sent: {codes}

diff.title: Difference Review
diff.noteChanged: This item changed during the stocktake
diff.frozenNote: Voided or deleted items cannot be adjusted. Restore the item or handle it offline
diff.allDone: All differences processed. The stocktake is now confirmed
diff.lossHint: Not scanned. Will be removed from this warehouse's stock
diff.gainHint: Not in stock in the system. Will be added to this warehouse's stock
diff.whHint: In stock at another warehouse. Will be moved to this warehouse

venue.title: Venue Management
venue.note: The venue code is the first two characters of item codes and cannot be changed after creation.
venue.codeInvalid: The code must be two uppercase letters (A-Z)
venue.name: Name

band.title: Price Band Management
band.note: The band code is the last character of item codes. Overlapping ranges cannot be saved.
band.codeInvalid: The code must be one uppercase letter (A-Z)
band.hint: Ranges are treated as [lower, upper): leave the lower bound blank for no bottom limit, or the upper bound blank for no top limit.
band.lowerInvalid: The lower bound must be a non-negative integer (JPY)
band.upperInvalid: The upper bound must be a positive integer (JPY)
band.rangeInvalid: The lower bound must be less than the upper bound

user.title: User Accounts
user.note: Accounts cannot be deleted (disable only). Disabling takes effect immediately.
user.passwordHint: At least 10 characters; a change is required on first sign-in
user.passwordInvalid: Initial password must be at least 10 characters
user.resetNote: The new initial password is shown only once on this screen. Hand it to the user (a change is required on first sign-in).

errors.400009: Order files must be 5MB or smaller.
errors.400011: The order file exceeds the row limit (100,000).
errors.400012: The order file (xlsx) could not be read. Upload the Yahoo order Excel as is.
errors.400013: Excel files must be 20MB or smaller.
errors.400014: The Excel file could not be read. Download the template and use the correct format.
errors.400015: The Excel file exceeds the row limit (20,000 rows).
errors.400016: The upload exceeds the size limit.
errors.400102: New password does not meet the requirements
errors.403001: You do not have permission to perform this action
errors.403002: Access from this origin is not allowed
errors.404002: No price band matches this price. Please configure price bands in the admin console
errors.404003: The selected auction venue does not exist
errors.409000: This item was updated by someone else. Reload the page and try again.
errors.409003: This price band code already exists
errors.409004: The price band range overlaps an existing band
errors.409006: This item has already been voided.
errors.409007: The source item has not been voided. Void it first.
errors.409008: This operation is not allowed in the item's current state. Reload the page and check again.
errors.409009: An active stocktake already exists for this warehouse. Continue the existing stocktake
errors.409010: This stocktake cannot be modified in its current state. Reload the page and check again
errors.409011: This exact order file has already been imported.
errors.409012: This exact Excel file has already been imported.
errors.409013: Warehouse changes must be made through a move operation.
errors.409014: This item has already been deleted.
errors.409015: This item is not deleted and cannot be restored.
errors.423001: Account locked. Please try again later
errors.429001: Submission limit exceeded. Please try again later
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Please check your network
errors.INVALID_RESPONSE: Received an invalid response from the server

import.title: Order import
import.hint: Order file (xlsx) downloaded from Yahoo Auction order management (up to 5MB). Processing takes a few seconds; results appear in the history below.
import.roleDenied: Importing requires Editor role or above.
import.emptyHint: Import an order file with the button above and the processing result will appear here.
import.unmatchedNote: Unmatched rows are listed below with the code exactly as it appears in the order file. Once the item is registered, the next import will match it (codes in the old system format never match).
import.unmatchedRows: Unmatched rows (self-code as in the order file)
import.unmatchedEmpty: This batch has no unmatched rows right now (they may have been reconciled by a later import).

shipments.title: Pending shipments
shipments.emptyHint: Import a Yahoo order file and the products waiting to ship will appear here.

reconcile.title: Reconciliation
reconcile.emptyHint: Import an order file to see mismatches such as sold but not shipped here.
reconcile.note: Rows that are on Yahoo but not in this system are listed under Unmatched rows in each import report (expand the row to see the original self-codes).

import.title: Import
import.roleDenied: Importing requires editor role or above.
import.hint: Upload a file in the same format as the template item sheet (19 columns). Rows without an item code get one generated; rows with a code are registered as-is.
import.emptyHint: Import an Excel file with the button above and the history will appear here.
import.noteHint: The numbering note records when importing existing codes advanced the counter (e.g. A0→A5). Later generated codes continue from the advanced position.

export.title: Export
export.codePlaceholder: Enter to export that single item
export.hint: Exports a report (25 columns). The created date range is required; the file includes total cost and profit.
export.rangeInverted: The start date is after the end date.

items.title: Item List
items.searchPlaceholder: Search by item code, name, venue, shelf no., etc.
items.searchHint: Letter case and kana type (hiragana/katakana) are ignored
items.loadFailed: Failed to load the item list.

recycle.note: Deleted items can be restored from here.

detail.title: Item Details
detail.notFound: This item does not exist or has been deleted.
detail.divergence: Current values differ from those issued with the item code
detail.deleteNote: This item will be marked as deleted. Deleted items can be restored from "Deleted items".

edit.title: Edit item
edit.note: The item code will not change.
edit.warehouseHint: Only items in transit can change warehouse. For in-stock items, use "Move" on the scan screen.
edit.versionConflict: Someone else has updated this item. Please reload the latest data.
edit.validationRequired: Venue, won date, purchase price, and warehouse are required.
edit.validationPrice: Enter a purchase price between 1 and 99,999,999.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.importHint: Import an order file from Yahoo linkage and the waiting counts will appear here.

settings.title: System Settings
settings.slowNote: Items held longer than the yellow threshold are flagged as caution in the item list; past the red threshold, as action needed.
settings.errDaysRange: Thresholds must be between {min} and {max} days
settings.errWarnLtAlarm: The yellow threshold must be smaller than the red threshold
settings.labelNote: Default label size for label printing. Choose Custom to specify width and height.
settings.errWidthRange: Label width must be between {min} and {max} mm
settings.errHeightRange: Label height must be between {min} and {max} mm

ledgers.title: Ledger Browser
ledgers.hint: The range includes both the from and to dates. Click a row to open the item.

oplogs.title: Operation Log
oplogs.hint: Logs are append-only. Expand a row to view the detail JSON.

guide.title: Add to Home Screen
guide.body: Installing as an app keeps temporarily stored photos safer (without adding to the home screen, stored photos may be cleared after long inactivity).
guide.ios: Safari Share button → "Add to Home Screen"
guide.generic: Browser menu → "Install app" / "Add to Home Screen"

warning.title: {n} photo(s) pending upload
warning.body: Photos may be cleared after long inactivity if the app is not added to the home screen. Uploads resume automatically once back online.
